heading: 11.2 Format types
text:
### 11.2 Format types [LUNI.11.2]

One of the interpolation format types ([LGRA.2.9.6.1]) exists for unit-typed
values, and [LGRA.2.9.6.10] states how it renders.

- **`u`** — the unit's label alone (`"celsius"`). A value with its label is
  written as two sites, `{x} {x:u}`. On a number with no unit, `u` is refused
  with `DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_UNIT_NON_UNIT`.

The complex type's `i` and `j` ([LUNI.14.8]) are deferred with it, and v1
refuses them ([LUNI.14.9]).
